summary: Aurora Cannabis Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its management information circular and notice of annual general meeting for shareholders scheduled for August 7, 2026. The circular covers routine items: election of directors, appointment of auditor, and an advisory say-on-pay vote. The letter from the executive chairman and CEO reviews fiscal 2026 financial results, including record medical cannabis revenue of $289 million and adjusted EBITDA of $54 million, and notes the recent U.S. rescheduling of cannabis. There are no special-situation proposals or transactions. No deal terms, advisors, or strategic actions are mentioned. This is a standard annual meeting filing.
